title: Pricing: Starter, Pro and Premium Plans | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC pricing: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. Credits are what you spend on a photo or video.
h1: AIVideosUGC Pricing for Product Photos and Videos
lead: Choose a credit plan for product photos and short video ads. AIVideosUGC shows the charge for each job before you approve it.
card: Starter, Pro, and Premium, with a set credit balance each month.
intro: Starter gives you 200 credits for $24.50 per month. Pro gives you 300 for $35, and Premium gives you 600 for $63. Use the same balance for listing photos and video ads.
credits_explained: One product photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24, a 10-second video uses 40, a 15-second video uses 60, and a 30-second video uses 120. The amount appears before you confirm the job.
A job reserves its credits while it runs and charges them when the file is ready. When a job fails, the reserved credits return to your balance automatically.
teams: If your shop or agency needs more than Premium, email support@aivideosugc.com with the number of photos and videos you plan to make each month.

faq.q: Which plan fits a small shop?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 per month for 200 credits. Choose Pro at $35 for 300 or Premium at $63 for 600 when your product content schedule needs a larger balance.

faq.q: Can photos and videos use one credit balance?
faq.a: Yes. Both formats draw from the same monthly credits, and the charge for each job is shown before you approve it.

faq.q: How much does a product photo or video cost?
faq.a: A product photo uses 24 credits. Videos use 24 credits at 6 seconds, 40 at 10, 60 at 15, or 120 at 30.

faq.q: What happens if a job fails?
faq.a: The credits reserved for that job are returned to your balance automatically. Check the job record if the balance has not updated, then contact support.

faq.q: Can I use the files in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. You may use downloaded photos and videos for your store, marketplaces, and social advertising. Follow the publishing rules of each platform.

faq.q: Are downloads free of a watermark?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos and videos do not carry an AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Are my uploads private on each plan?
faq.a: Yes. Uploads and finished files remain in your account on Starter, Pro, and Premium. They are not published to other customers.

faq.q: Can I request a review of a charge?
faq.a: A delivered file is not refunded because you dislike the result. A failed job returns its credits automatically; for a charge review, use the [Refund Policy](/refunds) and email support.

cta_title: Choose a Credit Plan for Your Next Asset
cta_lead: Pick the monthly balance that fits how many photos and videos you make, and start with your next listing or ad.
